description: Toll Calculator is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This is a dataset that contains the Toll Information. Please refer to rms. nsw. gov. au/sydney-motorways/toll-charges/index. html for the updated toll charges. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Calculator, Motorway, RMS, Sydney, Toll. It offers 3 resource(s) in data, docx, xlsx. The portal shows 2025-02-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
